note: Measured in this project on 2026-10-06 (Intel CPU, 32 logical cores; NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU 8 GB). Run times are wall clock of a 10-round, 3-client run (scaling attack, final gate) from the runner's start; 'server_to_last_round' is from the server log. Trace = one SL trace of a model over 32 probe images.
optimisations: Exact batched layer statistics (707 -> 108 ms per trace on CPU)
Decoded images cached in memory (3.1 -> 0.06 s per client epoch, bit-identical tensors)
Torch threads capped per simulated client (1.63 -> 0.77 s per epoch with 3 clients)
No start-up stagger, no post-submit sleep, event-driven round wake-up
CUDA build of PyTorch; tracing with cuDNN TF32 off for parity with CPU traces
